title: Bridge design and evaluation sheet
subject: Art & Design
unit: Spring 2: Still life and a paper bridge (Still Life and Can You Make a Paper Bridge?)
source: Written for art/y2 lesson 9 (Bridge design and evaluation sheet (portal printable; assessed))
intro: Lesson 9: Improve and test the paper bridge (DT). Listen, look, then do the tasks with a grown-up.

parts.text: Plan: add a flat deck on top
Tape the deck to the zigzag
Test: add coins one by one

box.title: Draw your bridge design and label the folds and materials

keywords.def: say what is good and what to improve
does not break or bend easily

questions.q: Draw your improved bridge plan and label one change.
questions.a: A plan with a labelled change

questions.q: Core: Make and test your improved bridge. Record the coins.
questions.a: A result recorded and compared with the first test

questions.q: Extend: Write: 'My bridge was better because ...'
questions.a: For example: the deck spread the weight
Any sensible change, for example smaller folds

options: To see if our change worked
